functional_correctness.description: Evaluates if the code meets the functional requirements specified in the task prompt.

bug_sensitivity.description: Assesses the code's ability to handle cases with subtle bugs or edge cases that could lead to incorrect results.

efficiency.description: Measures the time and space complexity of the solution in relation to the task's requirements.

robustness.description: Evaluates how well the code handles unexpected inputs or edge cases.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriateness and correctness of API or library usage in the solution.

readability.description: Evaluates the clarity of the code, including naming conventions, comments, and structure.

maintainability.description: Measures how easy it is to modify the code in the future, considering structure and documentation.

error_handling.description: Assesses how well the code handles errors and special cases, including security vulnerabilities.
